accepted.hypothesis: Killing the checkoutservice pod will cause the place order workflow to fail, as checkoutservice is the orchestrator for order placement.
accepted.expected_invariant: frontend HTTP 200 and successful order response with order_id and shipping_tracking_id
accepted.validation_plan: baseline, inject, observe, recover, cleanup, washout
accepted.recovery_expectation: After pod restart, checkoutservice becomes available and order placement succeeds.
accepted.weakness_surface: checkoutservice is a critical dependency in the order placement workflow; its absence breaks the business transaction.

accepted.hypothesis: Killing the cartservice pod will cause the add item step to fail, preventing the order from being placed.
accepted.expected_invariant: frontend HTTP 200 and successful order response with order_id and shipping_tracking_id
accepted.validation_plan: baseline, inject, observe, recover, cleanup, washout
accepted.recovery_expectation: After pod restart, cartservice becomes available and add item succeeds.
accepted.weakness_surface: cartservice is required for adding items to the cart; without it, the workflow cannot proceed.

accepted.hypothesis: Killing the frontend pod will cause the health check to fail, breaking the entire workflow.

accepted.recovery_expectation: After pod restart, frontend becomes available and health check succeeds.
accepted.weakness_surface: frontend is the entry point; its unavailability directly impacts the health check and user interactions.

accepted.hypothesis: Killing the productcatalogservice pod will cause product listing to fail, preventing item selection and order placement.
